thread_text:
marta: Heads-up: canary on raven-int8 is spiking funcall parse failures. Saw ~3% parse errors in the last 2h, mostly non-json suffixes that include a 0x1E-like control char mid-stream.
jamie: ugh. is it on streaming responses or final payloads?
sanjay: looks like streaming. chunks arriving with an extra RS (record-sep) byte that breaks our ndjson/funcall detector.
leah: do we have examples? can you paste raw bytes?
marta: pasted sample in case history: 
```
..."content": "...\x1e\"name\": \"do_thing\", \"arguments\": {\"x\": 1}}\n```
(note the \x1e before the object)
jamie: interesting — tokenization or kernel change could emit that as a control token. We saw similar once with a tokenizer update that emitted U+001E as part of streaming boundary.
sanjay: timeline: this started after the latest ptq canary (raven-int8) rolled at 02:10. previous canary (raven-q4) fine.
leah: quick mitigation: strip non-printables from stream before parsing? naive but fast.
marta: agreed for hotfix. but we need to preserve structured output—can't accidentally concatenate two JSONs.
jamie: propose a 2-pronged approach: 1) client-side soft-clean (strip/replace isolated control chars) + heuristic separator detection. 2) server-side telemetry+canary to attribute to tokenization/kernel.
sanjay: adding notes: retry_budget interactions — if middleware strips the RS and yields valid JSON, retries will look like success but mask root cause. we should tag repaired responses as repaired=true in telemetry.
leah: patch suggestion (quick python snippet):
```python
import re
# remove C0 control chars except newline/tab
clean = re.sub(r"[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F]", "", raw_bytes.decode('latin1'))
# then feed to parser
```
jamie: also for streaming: on chunk boundary, treat leading control char before '{' as noise only if previous chunk ended with '}' or '\n'. otherwise be conservative.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary raven-int8 reverted at 6429876600 (auto rollback policy triggered).
marta: thanks ops-bot. rollback lowered parse error rate to baseline. good signal that model/kernel change caused it.
sanjay: next steps: run targeted tokenizer diff between raven-int8 and raven-q4 on our canary prompts. run a token-by-token compare for the failing example.
leah: I'll add a tiny canary postprocess that marks repaired responses: {"_repaired": true} in metadata and emits metric `funcall.parse.repaired` with labels (model, canary, prompt_id).
jamie: add an e2e unit that streams the broken sequence through the runtime->client path to ensure we don't break multipart outputs.
marta: also add a short-lived eval: sample 10k hosted requests, run parser with 'strict' and 'repair' paths and diff rates. we want to quantify coverage and false positives.
sanjay: for longer term: file an infra ticket to pin kernel/tokenizer table for this model variant and add a preflight tokenization sanity check during onboarding: detect control chars emitted at token boundaries.
leah: rollout plan: hotfix to add repair+telemetry to canary pool, run 4h, if repaired rate > 0.5% we block until tokenizer fix.
jamie: decision: hotfix + telemetry today, tokenizer diff + onboarding gate for next week.
marta: i'll open the PR for the repair snippet and telemetry tag now. cc @leah @sanjay.
ci-bot: CI: patch-marta/repair-telemetry — tests: unit_stream_parser (FAIL) — flaky streaming test triggered, investigating.
jamie: re: CI failure — likely our test didn't include RS-case. add regression test with a raw \x1e injection at chunk boundary.
leah: good call. I'll add tests and the metric emitter.
sanjay: other idea: we could implement a 'soft-json-wrap' where if a suffix looks like `\x1e{...}` we try to resync by removing leading control bytes up to first printable char and then parse. add rate cap (1%).
marta: fine as long as we mark repaired and keep retry budgets visible. we don't want silent heals.
jamie: logging: include original bytes (base64) in debug logs for 10% of repaired cases so we can triage tokenization patterns without leaking too much.
leah: putting TODOs in the PR: 1) repair function + tests 2) metric `funcall.parse.{repaired,strict_fail}` 3) canary job to compare token diffs 4) onboarding gate for token control chars.
ops-bot: incident-tracker: created INC-2026-143 for raven-int8 parse spike.
marta: thanks. will follow up after PR. short term: watchers, please mute alerts if you're oncall and the rollback is already in place. :pray:
jamie: FYI I'll schedule a 30m sync 1hr from now to review tokenizer diffs and decide whether to re-onboard with a patched tokenizer table.
leah: ack.
ci-bot: CI: patch-marta/repair-telemetry — unit_stream_parser (PASS) on retry-2.
marta: excellent. merging and will deploy to canary with repair+telemetry.
jamie: nice work. once canary runs, collect the `funcall.parse.repaired` / `funcall.parse.strict_fail` ratios and paste here.
sanjay: i'll run token diff job now and post summary in the sync.
leah: thanks team.
notes: control-char streaming issue, hotfix + telemetry, tokenizer diff and onboarding gate planned
